---
title: "leaflet.indoor Quarto example"
format: html
embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: true
---

```{r}
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.indoor)

leaflet(
  indoor_demo,
  options = leafletOptions(crs = leafletCRS("L.CRS.Simple"))
) |>
  addIndoor(
    label = ~name,
    popup = ~description,
    style = list(fillColor = ~fill),
    crs = "simple"
  ) |>
  addIndoorControl(position = "bottomright")
```
